newsitem.title: USA: Regions names president, sets split, raises div.
newsitem.headline: Regions names president, sets split, raises div.

text.p: Regions Financial Corp said on Wednesday that it had named Carl Jones president and chief operating officer, effective immediately, and that it plans a two-for-one stock split, effective June 1, 1997.
The company also increased its regular quarterly dividend to $0.40 a share from $0.35. The next dividend is payable April 1 to stockholders of record March 14.
Jones, currently president of the company's southern Alabama and Louisiana regions, will take on the additional duties of chief executive officer of the company in January 1998.
The position of president has been vacant since 1990, when Stan Mackin vacated the position to become CEO.
CEO Mackin will continue to be chairman of the board when Jones assumes the CEO position.
